Marginal probabilities of stopping ethnic minorities more than wHITE PEOPLE
```{r plot-marg-probs, results='hide', fig.keep='all', echo=F}
plot.marginal.probabilities <- function(marg.probs, areas) {
  
  areas$prob <- marg.probs[areas$police_force]
  
  ggplot(areas) +
    geom_sf(aes(fill = prob)) +
  scale_fill_gradient2(low="blue",mid="white", high="red", name="Marginal probability", limits=c(0,1), midpoint=0.5) +
  theme_classic() +
  theme(axis.line = element_blank(),
        axis.text = element_blank(),
        axis.ticks = element_blank(),
        strip.background = element_blank(),
        strip.text = element_text(size = rel(1.0), colour = "black"))
}

asian.probs <- rowMeans(overall.ex.sets$asian.ratios > 0)
black.probs <- rowMeans(overall.ex.sets$black.ratios > 0)

plot.marginal.probabilities(asian.probs, areas) + ggtitle("A") +
  plot.marginal.probabilities(black.probs, areas) + ggtitle("B") +
  plot_layout(guides="collect") 

ggsave("visualisations/marginal_probabilities.pdf", width=6, height=3, units="in")
```

Excursion function with asterisks at 95% level.
```{r plot-excursion-function, results='hide', fig.keep='all', echo=F}

asian.F <- t(overall.ex.sets$asian.F)

colnames(asian.F) <- rownames(overall.ex.sets$asian.ratios)
asian.all.upper <- asian.probs > 0.5

areas$f <- asian.F[,areas$police_force]
areas$upper <- asian.all.upper[areas$police_force]
areas$fsigned <- areas$f * (2*areas$upper - 1)


black.F <- t(overall.ex.sets$black.F)

colnames(black.F) <- rownames(overall.ex.sets$black.ratios)
black.all.upper <- black.probs > 0.5

areas$fblack <- black.F[,areas$police_force]
areas$upperblack <- black.all.upper[areas$police_force]
areas$fsignedblack <- areas$fblack * (2*areas$upperblack - 1)


asian.centroids <- areas %>%
  filter(police_force %in% overall.ex.sets$asian.upr) %>%
  st_centroid()


black.centroids <- areas %>%
  filter(police_force %in% overall.ex.sets$black.upr) %>%
  st_centroid()

p1 <- areas %>%
  ggplot() +
  geom_sf( aes(fill = fsigned)) +
  geom_text(data = asian.centroids, aes(geometry = geometry, label = "*"), 
            stat = "sf_coordinates", size = 8, color = "black", nudge_y = -0.15) +
  ggtitle("A")

p2 <- ggplot(areas) + geom_sf(aes(fill = fsignedblack)) +
  geom_text(data = black.centroids, aes(geometry = geometry, label = "*"), 
            stat = "sf_coordinates", size = 8, color = "black", nudge_y=-0.1) +
  ggtitle("B")



p1 + p2 + plot_layout(guides="collect") &
  scale_fill_gradient2(low="blue",mid="white", high="red", name="Level avoiding\nfunction", limits=c(-1,1), midpoint=0, breaks=seq(-1, 1, 0.5), labels = abs(seq(-1, 1, 0.5)))&
  theme_classic() &
  theme(axis.line = element_blank(),
        axis.text = element_blank(),
        axis.ticks = element_blank(),
        axis.title.x = element_blank(),
        axis.title.y = element_blank(),
        strip.background = element_blank(),
        strip.text = element_text(size = rel(1.0), colour = "black"))


ggsave("visualisations/excursion_function.pdf", width=6, height=3, units="in")

```

```{r plot-final-results}
plot.overall.excursion.sets <- function(excursion.sets, areas) {
  
  p1 <- areas %>%
    mutate(
      excursion.upr = police_force %in% excursion.sets$asian.upr,
      excursion.lwr = police_force %in% excursion.sets$asian.lwr,
      excursion = as.factor(excursion.upr - excursion.lwr)
    ) %>%
    ggplot() +
    geom_sf(aes(fill = excursion)) +
    theme_classic() +
    theme(axis.line = element_blank(),
          axis.text = element_blank(),
          axis.ticks = element_blank(),
          legend.position = "none",
          strip.background = element_blank(),
          strip.text = element_text(size = rel(1.0), colour = "black")) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = c("blue", "white", "red"), breaks = -1:1) +
    ggtitle("Upper level avoiding sets for bias against Asian people (left)\n and Black people (right)")
  
  p2 <- areas %>%
    mutate(
      excursion.upr = police_force %in% excursion.sets$black.upr,
      excursion.lwr = police_force %in% excursion.sets$black.lwr,
      excursion = as.factor(excursion.upr - excursion.lwr)
    ) %>%
    ggplot() +
    geom_sf(aes(fill = excursion)) +
    theme_classic() +
    theme(axis.line = element_blank(),
          axis.text = element_blank(),
          axis.ticks = element_blank(),
          legend.position = "none",
          strip.background = element_blank(),
          strip.text = element_text(size = rel(1.0), colour = "black")) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = c("blue", "white", "red"), breaks = -1:1) 
  
  return(p1+p2 )
} 


```

```{r map-probs-in-table}
all.probs <- asian.probs %>%
  as.data.frame() %>%
  rownames_to_column()

colnames(all.probs) <- c("police_force", "asian.probs")

all.probs <- all.probs %>%
  mutate(
    asian.f = asian.F[,police_force],
    asian.upr = ifelse(police_force %in% overall.ex.sets$asian.upr, "X", ""),
    black.probs = black.probs[police_force],
    black.f = black.F[,police_force],
    black.upr = ifelse(police_force %in% overall.ex.sets$black.upr, "X", ""),
    police_force = str_to_title(gsub("_", " ", police_force))
  )

require(knitr)

print(knitr::kable(all.probs,
             format = "latex",
             col.names = c("Police Force", "Marginal probability", "Joint probability", "95% set", "Marginal probability", "Joint probability", "95% set"),
             digits = 3))

```
